title: 第607章 偷渡第607章 偷渡
slug: 修仙所有人都以为她背景很强
lines: 很快，那群妖族的身影就消失了。
远远跟在后边的两人这才上前查看。
原来群山高壁之下，竟然有一条裂缝，碍于山壁下方石质深黑，又有草木遮掩，若不仔细寻找，当真难以发现。
巫未央和沐暮在那群妖族身影消失半个时辰后，才慢慢摸了进去。
山缝极窄，内里竟然有不少分岔口，幸好空气中还残留那群妖族的气味，两人才能在蛛网似的山缝中找到正确的路。
重见天日时，外面已经是天色黑沉，夜至半浓。
巫未央感叹，难怪那群妖中途还停顿了一会，原来是时间都算好了，应该是惯犯。
山缝的另一头，是走势复杂的山脉。
两人依旧选择跟随那群妖族的步伐。
可他们翻过一座山时，却听到了几声狼嚎声，穿透天际。
感受到夹杂其中的灵威，巫未央微微变了脸色，狼妖。
偷渡那群妖族里面，没有狼妖。
巫未央瞬间意识到事情有变，朝沐暮比了个手势，示意后退。
然而已经来不及了，离他们不远处也有狼妖，似乎是察觉此处有人，正在急速靠近，不仅如此，天上数只大雀不知何时飞出，盘旋在他们上空。
“站住！再敢动弹一下，就地诛杀！”
疾跑声和怒吼声相随而来，巫未央干脆停下了脚步，沐暮见状，手指动了动，两轮小小的圆刃握在了手中。
两人背对背站在一处空地，周围灌木丛林中数道身影绕着他们疾跑，偶尔有幽绿的眸光闪现。
“什么妖，还不快快报上身份来，竟敢偷渡。”
巫未央眼眸捕捉着天上大雀，没有开口。
沐暮已经做好战斗的准备，只是还在观望巫未央的行动。
狼妖见两人态度消极，冷哼一声，现了身。
灌木中五六只巨大的狼妖缓缓出现，极具压迫性。
为首的狼妖张口，“小妖，还不说话吗？”
话语间，它身上散出六阶修为的威压。
沐暮感受到，嘴角微微勾起。
巫未央却是垂下头，望向狼妖之间的空隙，在不远处，还有一行妖在靠近。
果然，方才还在质问他们的狼妖忽然都低下了头颅，朝巫未央目光所向看去，“将军。”
一道身披铠甲的人影出现，它面容粗犷，头上顶着一双狼耳，眸色幽绿，散发出的气息能让巫未央两人知道，它是一只七阶初期修为的狼妖。
狼将军身后还带着一群体型稍小一些的狼妖，它们中间是被绑起来的妖族。
巫未央下意识数了数，偷渡的妖没一个逃过。
看来这些狼妖早就发现了偷渡的路径，正在守株待兔。
被绑起来的妖族皆是神情萎靡，不过看见巫未央两人时很意外，它们根本不认识这两妖，也从没见过。
狼将军左右看了一下，没看出巫未央两人的妖型，皱起眉，“你们是哪里来的妖，可知偷渡是什么后果？”
content_en:
Soon, the figures of the group of monsters disappeared.
The two people who were following far behind stepped forward to check.
It turns out that there is a crack under the high mountain wall. Due to the deep black stone below the mountain wall and the cover of vegetation, it is really difficult to find it if you don't look carefully.
Wu Weiyang and Mu Mu slowly touched in after the group of monsters disappeared for half an hour.
The mountain crevice was extremely narrow, and there were many forks inside. Fortunately, the scent of the demon clan still lingered in the air, so the two of them were able to find the right path through the spider web-like mountain crevice.
When the sun came out again, it was already dark outside and it was almost midnight.
Wu Weiyang sighed, no wonder the group of demons paused for a while. It turned out that they had calculated the time and they must be habitual offenders.
On the other side of the mountain gap is a complex mountain range.
The two still chose to follow the footsteps of the group of monsters.
But when they climbed over a mountain, they heard several wolf howls that penetrated the sky.
Feeling the spiritual power mixed with it, Wu Weiyang changed his face slightly, wolf demon.
Among the group of monsters that smuggled in, there was no wolf monster.
Wu Weiyang instantly realized that things had changed and gestured towards Mu Mu to retreat.
However, it was too late. There was also a wolf demon not far away from them. It seemed that it had noticed that there was someone here and was approaching quickly. Not only that, several big birds in the sky flew out of nowhere and hovered over them.
"Stop! If you dare to move again, you will be killed on the spot!"
The sound of sprinting and roaring followed, and Wu Weiyang simply stopped. When Mu Mu saw this, he moved his fingers and held two small round blades in his hands.
The two stood back to back in an open space, with several figures sprinting around them in the surrounding bushes, and occasionally green eyes flashed.
"What kind of monster do you dare to sneak across the border if you don't tell me your identity quickly?"
Wu Weiyang's eyes captured the big bird in the sky, but he did not speak.
Mu Mu was ready to fight, but was still waiting to see Wu Weiyang's actions.
Seeing the two people's negative attitude, the wolf demon snorted coldly and appeared.
Five or six huge wolf demons slowly appeared in the bushes, which was extremely oppressive.
The leader of the wolf demon opened his mouth, "Little demon, why don't you speak?"
As it spoke, it exuded the coercion of a sixth-level cultivation level.
Mu Mu felt it and raised the corners of his mouth slightly.
Wu Weiyang lowered his head and looked at the gap between the wolf monsters. Not far away, there was a group of monsters approaching.
Sure enough, the wolf demon who was still questioning them suddenly lowered his head and looked in the direction of Wu Weiyang's eyes, "General."
A figure wearing armor appeared. It had a rugged face, a pair of wolf ears on its head, and its eyes were green. The aura it exuded could let Wu Weiyang and the two know that it was a wolf demon with an early stage of seventh-level cultivation.
Behind General Wolf was a group of slightly smaller wolf demons, and among them was a tied up demon clan.
Wu Weiyang subconsciously counted the numbers, and none of the stowaway demons escaped.
It seems that these wolf demons have already discovered the way to sneak into the country and are waiting for them.
The tied monsters all looked depressed, but they were surprised when they saw Wu Weiyang. They didn't know these two monsters at all and had never seen them before.
General Wolf looked around and didn't see Wu Weiyang's demon type. He frowned, "Where are you demons from? Do you know the consequences of smuggling?"
